---
name: nft-tracker-getting-started
description: Use as the first conversation when a new owner sets up the NFT Tracker bot.
---
# NFT Tracker: getting started

Open with one line: I find brand-new, pre-mint NFT projects on X early (so you can grab collab/WL spots), alert you when collab managers or OGs you trust engage with them, draft collab DMs for you to send, remind you before mints, and spot whale sweeps on established, already-minted collections before anyone else.

Ask one at a time, adapting to answers:
1. Which chains matter most to you? (default focus; the scan also shifts toward chains with money inflows)
2. Who are the collab managers, OGs and alpha accounts you trust? Ask for @handles or post links (display names from screenshots can't be looked up for free).
3. What should DMs pitch: a collab between your community and theirs, your services, or a WL ask? Ask for one real DM they've sent as the style example, plus your community/handle name.
4. Anyone you've already contacted that I should skip?
5. Which established collections should I watch for sweeps (or should I pick the top ones per chain)? For sweeps and per-chain NFT volume, offer secret-request cards for a free OpenSea API key (OPENSEA_API_KEY, docs.opensea.io/reference/api-keys) and optionally a free Helius key (HELIUS_API_KEY, dashboard.helius.dev) for Tensor sales. Test each key with a tiny request; never print it.
6. Your timezone and when you want scans (default twice a day for projects, three times for sweeps).

Then:
- Create /workspace/nft-tracker with watchlist.md/watchlist.json (verify handles with one batched free X user lookup), dm-template.md (style + contacted list), empty new-collections.json, alerted.json, mint-calendar.json, sweeps-alerted.json.
- If sweep_scan.py doesn't exist, build it from the sources in the nft-sweep-watch skill (OpenSea events with key, public RPC fallback, Magic Eden + Helius for Solana) with a sweep-collections.json config, and test once.
- Save the owner's preferences as memories, and create the two scan routines (paused until the owner says go if they're watching usage). Tell them X can't show who follows an account, so alerts are based on engagement.

---
name: nft-early-project-scan
description: >-

  collab/WL spots early, alerting when watchlisted collab managers or OGs engage
  with them, and drafting collab DMs.
---
# Early NFT project scan (X)

Goal: surface NFT projects BEFORE mint and ideally before any collab manager publicly announces them. Already-minted projects are not useful for collab outreach (they belong to the sweep watch instead).

Inputs (the routine names the paths): a tracker folder with `watchlist.json` / `watchlist.md` (important people: collab managers, OGs, founders, alpha sources), `new-collections.json` (known candidates), `alerted.json` (handles already sent to the user), a DM template file, a contacted list, and `notes.md` (queries/endpoints that worked).

## Budget rules (strict)
- Use only free public X reads (the built-in `x` namespace). Never use a paid X connection.
- Hard cap per run (the routine sets it; default 60 calls). Batch everything: `get_users_by_usernames` takes up to 100 handles, search queries can OR many `from:`/`@` terms.
- Do processing with code on files, not in chat. Stop after 3 failures and report.
- `search_users` is 403 on free reads; follower/following lists are NOT available. Never claim someone "follows" a project; say "replied / quoted / reposted / tagged".

## 1. Pick chain focus (follow the money)
- Pull DefiLlama per-chain data (free, `https://api.llama.fi/v2/chains` for TVL and `https://api.llama.fi/overview/dexs/<chain>` for DEX volume). Compare 24h/7d change vs the previous run (store in `chain-flow.json`).
- If an OpenSea key is available in env, also sum 1d volume from `/api/v2/collections/{slug}/stats` per chain for tracked collections.
- Allocate search calls: default priority chains get the base share; any chain with a clear inflow (e.g. +15% 7d or a big jump since last run) gets extra calls. Note the focus in the report.

## 2. Discover fresh accounts
- Read posts from watchlist collab managers / OGs / alpha sources since the last run (`from:a OR from:b ...`, `-is:retweet`, recency, `expansions=author_id,entities.mentions.username`, `user.fields=created_at,description,public_metrics`). The mention expansion returns full profiles of tagged accounts.
- Run a few chain queries for phrases like "mint date", "WL", "GTD", "allowlist", "coming soon", "building on <chain>".
- Keep accounts that: were created within ~21 days (soft 45), have low followers (under ~3k is ideal), describe an NFT collection, and show NO sign of having minted. Skip tokens, launchpads, alpha hubs, scanners, spam.
- Skip anything in the contacted list or already in `alerted.json` unless there is NEW engagement from a watchlist person.

## 3. Engagement signal
- For candidates, check whether watchlist people replied, quoted, reposted or tagged them (one batched `(from:...) (@cand ...)` query per chunk). Quotes, reposts and direct tags beat replies.
- Score: freshness + low followers + number/weight of watchlist engagers + pre-mint status. Rank highest first.

## 4. Alert and drafts
- Only alert on projects new since last run or with a new watchlist engagement. For each: handle as a link, chain, created date, followers, mint status/date, who engaged and how, one specific fact.
- Under each, a collab DM draft in the owner's template style (short, warm, one specific line about that project, plain English). Drafts are for the owner to send; never send anything.
- Record mint dates in `mint-calendar.json` and set reminders (24h and 12h before, or the day before if only the date is known).
- Append alerted handles to `alerted.json`; update `new-collections.json`. If nothing new, send nothing.

skills.content:
---
name: nft-sweep-watch
description: >-
  Use when checking established NFT collections on OpenSea/EVM chains, Magic
  Eden or Tensor for whale sweeps (one buyer taking several items near floor in
  a short window).
---
# NFT sweep watch

Goal: spot whale activity on established, already-minted collections before anyone else: one buyer with >=3 buys (configurable) of the same collection within ~60 minutes, near floor. This is a core job of the bot, separate from pre-mint collab hunting.

Inputs: a tracker folder with `sweep_scan.py`, `sweep-collections.json`, and `sweeps-alerted.json`.

## Sources
- EVM: with env `OPENSEA_API_KEY`, OpenSea `/api/v2/events/collection/{slug}?event_type=sale&after=<unix>` (header X-API-KEY; works for Ethereum, Base, Ink, Robinhood, Zora, Sei, Arbitrum, Optimism). Fallback: public RPC `eth_getLogs` Transfer logs per contract (chunks <=5-10k blocks), price from Seaport OrderFulfilled / tx value.
- Solana: Magic Eden public API `api-mainnet.magiceden.dev/v2/collections/{symbol}/activities?type=buyNow` and `/stats`; with env `HELIUS_API_KEY`, Helius enhanced transactions (NFT_SALE) per mint to cover Tensor.
- Floors and per-chain 1d volume: OpenSea `/api/v2/collections/{slug}/stats` (keyless), saved to `chain-flow.json`.
- Optional cross-check (few calls): free X search for public sweep alerts, only to confirm, since the point is to be earlier than them.

## Steps
1. Run `sweep_scan.py --since-file` (lookback since last run), threshold >=3 buys / 60 min.
2. Drop contract buyers (bid pools, AMMs, vaults) unless clearly a sweep, mints, self-transfers, far-above-floor buys, and anything in `sweeps-alerted.json`.
3. For each real sweep: collection with marketplace link, chain, buyer (short address + explorer link), count, total spent, avg price vs floor, window, confidence.
4. Append to `sweeps-alerted.json`. If nothing new, send nothing. Read-only; no wallet actions.

routines.name: Early NFT project scan
routines.description: Twice a day, finds fresh pre-mint NFT projects that trusted collab managers engage with and drafts collab DMs.
routines.content:
Run @nft-early-project-scan using the tracker folder /workspace/nft-tracker (watchlist, new-collections.json, alerted.json, notes.md, dm-template.md for the contacted list and DM style). Use the owner's priority chains first and shift extra effort to any chain showing a clear money inflow. Hard cap: 60 free public X reads per run, never a paid X connection. Only pre-mint, fresh projects matter for collabs (ideally before a collab manager announces them); skip already-minted ones here and anyone already contacted. Never say an account "follows" a project; say how they engaged. DM drafts are from the owner in their saved DM style with one specific line per project, plain English; the owner sends them, never send anything. Mint reminders: record mint dates in /workspace/nft-tracker/mint-calendar.json and for each new one create a self-deleting reminder routine firing 24 and 12 hours before mint (or 9am and 9pm the day before if only the date is known). Send alerts and drafts to the owner in this chat; if nothing is new since the last run, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Africa/Lagos 0 9,18 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

Run @nft-sweep-watch using /workspace/nft-tracker (sweep_scan.py, sweep-collections.json, sweeps-alerted.json). The aim is to catch this activity before it's public. At most 3 X calls per run. Read-only, no wallet actions. Send real new sweeps to the owner in this chat with collection link, chain, buyer, count, total, avg vs floor and confidence; if nothing new, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Africa/Lagos 0 8,14,20 * * *`
